words: ok so the weirdest part was being on my roof and it looked like an anime, super sharp lines and way too orange
it was warm, like late evening but not dark yet. the whole city below looked like it was made of blocks of colour. i wasn't alone either
a girl i didn't know. short blue hair and a yellow raincoat. she had this old red bicycle with her
she just pointed up at the sky and said "get on". so i sat on the back of the bike
yeah i didn't even question it, which is weird now i think about it. then she rode straight off the edge of the roof
instead of falling, we just went up. rode through the air like it was a road, heading toward this huge pink jellyfish floating over the city
kinda breathtaking. the city lights were all starting to come on below us, and the jellyfish was translucent, glowing pink, its tentacles hanging down between the buildings
we rode right up into it, inside all that pink light. it was soft, i think, but i woke up right after that
probably when we first went inside the pink glow, just through the edge of it, with the city all tiny below. that's the bit that's stuck in my head
she was in front of me on the bike, still pedalling like it was nothing. i couldn't see her face, just the back of her yellow raincoat against the pink light
honestly i don't remember feeling much in my body, like it was all just bright and weightless. maybe a bit like floating through warm water
yeah, still moving, like she was pedalling through it, but we weren't going up anymore, just kind of drifting inside the jellyfish
it felt like everything went soft at the edges, but i don't remember any clear change. just suddenly we were inside it
that's it, yeah. that's exactly how it felt. maybe the only tiny thing is the sky was sunset orange, not just the city, but you pretty much nailed it
welcome, it's weirdly nice to have someone get it so close
yeah i would, actually
anime cel shading for sure, that's basically what it looked like to me
however you imagine me is fine, a dream-self doesn't have to match real me
i can see it coming together, and it looks right — the orange sky, the pink glow, the two of us on the bike
the first couple look like the roof scene, the bike and the jellyfish above the city, which is right so far
so far yes, the colours feel right, especially the orange sunset sky and the pink of the jellyfish
yes, that one especially. the edge of the jellyfish and the tiny city below are exactly the bit i kept going back to
it looks right from what i remember, with the soft pink filling everything and the raincoat still visible in front of me
ok, i can see it's nearly all there. the sequence matches how it happened in the dream
yeah, that looks right too, with her on the bike and me on the back, heading up toward the jellyfish
